answer: Co-located compute attestation. Each agent identity must pass a timing challenge whose response depends on its host machine’s unique memory-latency fingerprint, verified against a signed observation from an independent raven node. A lone operator running many identities on one host cannot produce distinct fingerprints, and renting separate hardware costs far more than the reward per identity. The raven node times responses across a random signal pattern, so virtualized clones leak a shared cache profile. Any identity whose fingerprint matches another is ejected to a probationary ledge,
